signature: type Record struct { Name string `json:"name"`; Value int64 `json:"value"` }; func BENCH_FN(chunks [][]byte, limit int) ([]Record, error)
instruction: Repair {{symbol}} in {{entry}}, package benchmark. Parse a sequence of arbitrary byte chunks as NDJSON records. Records are closed objects with nonempty name string and integer value int64; malformed UTF-8, unknown/duplicate fields, missing fields and multiple JSON values on a line are errors. Support CRLF, a final line without newline and empty lines. limit is a positive maximum line byte length excluding LF and optional final CR. Bound the carried partial line to limit+1 bytes. Return all records only on total success; any error returns nil,error, never a partial prefix. Empty valid input returns a non-nil empty slice.
